runs.summary: Data through Oct 23 (Q4 17-day partial). Top 3: XLE +58.1%, CIBR +48.9%, SMH +46.4%. SPY P/E: 24.46x
runs.content:
Top 5 YTD 2026: XLE +58.1% (P/E 18.48x, Fair), CIBR +48.9% (36.55x, Expensive), SMH +46.4% (29.01x, Elevated), XLK +27.7% (31.88x, Elevated), XBI +22.8% (22.23x*, Fair, profitable holdings only).

Bottom 5 YTD 2026: XLC -9.6% (15.54x, Fair), GLD -7.5% (P/E N/A), JETS -7.0% (13.10x, Cheap), XME -6.8% (16.02x, Fair), GDX -6.5% (12.65x, Cheap).

Notable shifts: Tech split. CIBR rebounded ~7% (Q4 -4.1% -> +2.9%), crossed back into Expensive (36.55x) and moved Consolidating -> Continuing, overtaking SMH for #2. SMH kept sliding (Q4 -13.4%). Gold sold off: GDX -8.6% on the week (now -6.5% YTD) and GLD -4.0%; both Fading -> Reversing. XLC Fading -> Reversing and is now the weakest sector. XLV's 33.47x confirms last week's re-rating. ICLN P/E rose 16.33x -> 19.74x on a falling price (recheck). Defensives keep leading Q4 (XLP +9.5%, XLU +7.9%, KIE +7.6%). SPY is +12.3% YTD (Q4 -0.4%); 10 of 25 sectors beat it (KRE new). 8 sectors negative YTD (GDX joined).
